title: Characteristic Binding Landscape of Estrogen Receptor-alpha36 Protein Enhances Promising Cancer Drug Design.
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子分子动力学模拟和MM/PBSA研究雌激素受体ER-alpha36与配体BFB的结合动态，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD/结合自由能方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模，故给予中档评分。
abstract: Breast cancer (BC) remains the most common cancer among women worldwide, and estrogen receptor-alpha expression is a critical diagnostic factor for BC. Estrogen receptor (ER-alpha36) is a dominant-negative effector of ER-alpha66-mediated estrogen-responsive gene pathways. ER-alpha36 is a novel target that mediates the non-genomic estrogen signaling pathway. However, the crystallized structure of ER-alpha36 remains unavailable for molecular studies. ER-positive and triple-negative BC tumors aggressively resist the FDA-approved drugs; therefore, highly potent structure-based inhibitors with preeminent benefits over toxicity will preferably replace the current BC treatment. Broussoflanol B (BFB), a B. papyrifera bark compound, exhibits potent growth inhibitory activity in ER-negative BC cells by inducing cell cycle arrest. For the first time, we unravel the comparative dynamic events of the enzymes' structures and the binding mechanisms of BFB when bound to the ER-alpha36 and ER-alpha66 ligand-binding domain using an all-atom molecular dynamics simulations approach and MM/PBSA-binding-free energy calculations. The dynamic findings have revealed that ER-alpha36 and ER-alpha66 LBD undergo timescale "coiling", opening and closing conformations favoring the high-affinity BFB-bound ER-alpha36 (DeltaG = -52.57 kcal/mol) compared to the BFB-bound ER-alpha66 (DeltaG = -42.41 kcal/mol). Moreover, the unbound (1.260 A) and bound ER-alpha36 (1.182 A) exhibit the highest flexibilities and atomistic motions relative to the ER-alpha66 systems. The RMSF (A) of the unbound ER-alpha36 and ER-alpha66 exhibit lesser stabilities than the BFB-bound systems, resulting in higher structural flexibilities and atomistic motions than the bound variants. These findings present a model that describes the mechanisms by which the BFB compound induces downregulation-accompanied cell cycle arrest at the Gap(0) and Gap(1) phases.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌（BC）仍是全球女性中最常见的癌症，而雌激素受体α表达是BC的关键诊断因素。雌激素受体（ER-alpha36）是ER-alpha66介导的雌激素响应基因通路中的显性负效应因子。ER-alpha36是介导非基因组雌激素信号通路的新靶点。然而，ER-alpha36的晶体结构仍无法用于分子研究。ER阳性和三阴性BC肿瘤对FDA批准的药物具有强烈耐药性；因此，具有卓越毒性优势的高效基于结构的抑制剂有望取代当前BC治疗。Broussoflanol B（BFB），一种来自B. papyrifera树皮的化合物，通过诱导细胞周期阻滞，在ER阴性BC细胞中表现出强效生长抑制活性。我们首次利用全原子分子动力学模拟方法和MM/PBSA结合自由能计算，揭示了ER-alpha36和ER-alpha66配体结合域与BFB结合时的酶结构比较动态事件及结合机制。动态研究发现，ER-alpha36和ER-alpha66 LBD经历时间尺度的“卷曲”、开放和闭合构象，有利于高亲和力的BFB结合ER-alpha36（DeltaG = -52.57 kcal/mol），相较于BFB结合ER-alpha66（DeltaG = -42.41 kcal/mol）。此外，未结合（1.260 Å）和结合状态的ER-alpha36（1.182 Å）相对于ER-alpha66系统表现出最高的灵活性和原子运动。未结合ER-alpha36和ER-alpha66的RMSF（Å）显示出比BFB结合系统更低的稳定性，导致比结合变体更高的结构灵活性和原子运动。这些发现提出一个模型，描述了BFB化合物在Gap(0)和Gap(1)期诱导伴随下调的细胞周期阻滞的机制。
